_comment: Pixel regions of clues/welcome-to-the-brave-new-world.png (1600x1200) that carry candidate seed signal. Boxes are [x0, y0, x1, y1] in the original image's pixel coordinates. The clock box matches the crop used to measure the dial rotation; the rune-column and monument boxes match the crops used to transcribe the geometric-rune script and the 13th Amendment engraving. Produced by measuring the source image directly, not inherited from any third-party claim.

regions.name: dial
regions.label: rotated dial, two labeled pointers (MOON, TOWER)
regions.note: rotation measured at about -73 degrees from vertical, not a multiple of 30 degrees; digits 5 and 6 are not legible

regions.name: monument
regions.label: pedestal engraving (13th Amendment text, SUBJECT underlined)
